name: busyants
description: Lets Claude read your BusyAnts boards and add to them: checklist items, notes, checklists, columns and boards.
long_description: Connects Claude to your BusyAnts boards. Claude can list and read your boards (shared boards too, read-only), and on your own boards add, edit, tick and move checklist items and add notes, checklists, columns and boards. Every change is saved online at once, like a change made in the app; before its first change in a session, a copy of your boards is kept in Version history. You sign in with your own Google account in your web browser: ask Claude to "sign in to BusyAnts". Deleting is off unless it is switched on from the project’s code (npm run mcp:delete-on); Claude can’t switch it.

tools.name: list_boards
tools.description: Lists every BusyAnts board, with counts of columns, cards and open checklist items.

tools.name: read_board
tools.description: Reads one board as an outline: columns, cards, checklists with their items, notes.

tools.name: add_items
tools.description: Adds items to a checklist on one of your own boards.

tools.name: edit_items
tools.description: Changes checklist items' text on one of your own boards.

tools.name: set_items_done
tools.description: Ticks or unticks checklist items on one of your own boards.

tools.name: move_items
tools.description: Moves checklist items to a checklist on the same board.

tools.name: add_note
tools.description: Adds a note to one of your own boards.

tools.name: add_checklist
tools.description: Adds a checklist to one of your own boards.

tools.name: add_column
tools.description: Adds an empty column to one of your own boards.

tools.name: create_board
tools.description: Makes a new, empty board in your own boards.

tools.name: preview_delete
tools.description: Step 1 of 2 for deleting: shows what would be deleted. Works only when deleting is switched on.

tools.name: confirm_delete
tools.description: Step 2 of 2 for deleting, with a copy kept in Version history. Works only when deleting is switched on.

tools.name: sign_in
tools.description: Opens a sign-in page in your web browser, where you sign in with your own Google account.

tools.name: sign_out
tools.description: Signs this connector out on this computer. Nothing on the boards changes.
